text: Arsenal have reached an agreement in principle to pay Newcastle 90m euros (£77m) to sign Brazil midfielder Bruno Guimaraes, 28. (L'Equipe - in French)
Inter Milan are willing to pay £30m for England midfielder Curtis Jones, but Liverpool value the 25 year-old at £35m. (Mail)

Inter Milan's move for Tottenham 's Cristian Romero has stalled over his personal terms and the Argentina defender's representatives are now exploring a move to Spain, with Real Madrid , Barcelona and Atletico Madrid all interested in the 28-year-old. (Teamtalk)
AC Milan have been in contact with Arsenal over a potential deal for English winger Ethan Nwaneri, 19. (Corriere dello Sport - in Italian)
Real Madrid have no plans to increase their latest renewal offer to Vinicius Jr and are open to selling the Brazil forward, 26, if he does not agree a new contract. (ESPN)
Newcastle United are closing in on the £25m signing of Czech Republic goalkeeper Lukas Hornicek, 24, from Braga . (Talksport)
Hull City face a fight to secure the signing of Neom's Amadou Kone as Leeds and West Ham are among the other clubs interested in the Ivorian midfielder, 21. (Teamtalk)
West Ham are looking to sign English winger Morgan Whittaker, 25, from Championship rivals Middlesbrough before the start of the new season. (Talksport)
Middlesbrough are finalising an agreement to sign USA wing-back Max Arfsten, 25, from Columbus Crew in a deal worth up to £5.6m. (Goal)
Wolves have rejected a bid from Real Sociedad for Czech Republic centre-back Ladislav Krejci, 27. (Fabrizio Romano)
Everton , Leeds United and Nottingham Forest are monitoring English forward Liam Delap, 23, who Chelsea value at up to £40m. (The i)
Manchester City are in advanced talks with Lille for 18-year-old Morocco midfielder Ayyoub Bouaddi, who has also attracted interest from Arsenal , Chelsea , Liverpool and Bayern Munich . (Talksport)
Mamadou Sangare's move to Brentford is imminent, with the 24-year-old Mali midfielder leaving Lens' pre-season tour of Italy. (L'Equipe - in French, subscription required)
Fulham have agreed deals to sign Spain forward Gonzalo Garcia, 22, and 21-year-old midfielder Cesar Palacios from Real Madrid for a combined £43m. (Athletic - subscription required)
Manchester City are eyeing Marseille and Argentina goalkeeper Geronimo Rulli, 34, as a replacement for James Trafford. (ESPN)
Manchester United are preparing a bid for Newcastle and England defender Lewis Hall, 21, with Spanish 19-year-old Jorge Salinas of Racing Santander a possible alternative. (Teamtalk)
Coventry City are finalising an agreement with Brighton for 25-year-old English goalkeeper Carl Rushworth, who spent last season on loan with the Sky Blues. (Sky Sports)
Hull City have held positive talks with Augsburg's German midfielder Mert Komur, 21. (Florian Plettenberg on X)
Manchester United have held talks with San Lorenzo and Paraguay goalkeeper Orlando Gill, according to the 26-year-old's agent. (DSports via Metro)
Swedish defender Genesis Antwi, 19, is set to join Chelsea 's sister club Strasbourg on loan. (Football Insider)

Real Madrid are confident of signing 30-year-old Spain midfielder Rodri - who has one year left on his contract with Manchester City - for 40-50m euros (£34m-£43m) and a deal could be finalised after a meeting on Thursday. (AS - in Spanish)

Inter Milan could rekindle their efforts to sign England midfielder Curtis Jones, 25, from Liverpool . Meanwhile, the signing of England centre-back John Stones, 32, on a free transfer could scupper 28-year-old Argentina defender Cristian Romero's hopes of joining the Italian club from Tottenham . (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)

Juventus have agreed a deal with Paris St-Germain to sign France striker Randal Kolo Muani from the French champions. The move is for a loan with an obligation to buy and the fee could reach 50m euros (£43m) with add-ons. (Sky Sports Italia - in Italian)
Brentford are close to signing Lens and Mali midfielder Mamadou Sangare, 24, as a replacement for Jordan Henderson. (Evening Standard)
Aston Villa have had a 30m euro (£26m) offer for Brazilian forward Allan, 22, rejected by Palmeiras. (ESPN)
Hull City are in talks with Aston Villa to sign 28-year-old Jamaica winger Leon Bailey on a permanent transfer. (Sky Sports)

Fulham are getting closer to signing Spanish duo Cesar Palacios, a 21-year-old attacking midfielder, and 22-year-old Gonzalo Garcia, who is a striker, from Real Madrid, where new Cottagers boss Alvaro Arbeloa had a stint as manager last season. (Athletic - subscription required)

Nottingham Forest have had a 20m euro offer for 21-year-old Israel international Anan Khalaili, who can play as a right-sided wing-back or winger, rejected by Belgian club Royale Union Saint-Gilloise. (Athletic - subscription required)

Manchester United are open to selling 22-year-old Czech goalkeeper Radek Vitek and English defender Harry Amass, 19, while English midfielders Toby Collyer, 22, and Dan Gore, 21, are also surplus to requirements. (Mail – subscription required)
Nottingham Forest are in line to sign Portuguese midfielder Gustavo Sa from Famalicao , with the 21-year-old then expected to move to Greek side Olympiacos on loan. (Athletic - subscription required)
Crystal Palace 's move for Augsburg's 24-year-old French defender Chrislain Matsima has stalled and the Eagles are looking at other targets. (Standard)
Ipswich Town are eyeing a move for Standard Liege's English defender Henry Lawrence, 24, who previously played for Chelsea . (Football Insider)

Paris St-Germain and France forward Bradley Barcola, 23, has verbally agreed to join Liverpool , but there is no certainty over a move as there is a significant gap between the two clubs on the fee. (L'Equipe - in French)
Barcola's possible move to Liverpool could lead to Ligue 1 champions PSG trying to beat Real Madrid to the signing of Ivory Coast winger Yan Diomande, 19, from RB Leipzig. (L'Equipe - in French)

Real Madrid do not intend to sell 26-year-old Brazil forward Vinicius Jr, whose contract with the Spanish club runs out next summer, and are confident he will agree a new deal with the club. (Sky Sports)

Newcastle United sources insist the club are not in talks with Arsenal over a deal to sell Magpies skipper Bruno Guimaraes, 28, to the Gunners and the Tyneside club expect the Brazil international to return to training on Friday. (Northern Echo)

Bayern Munich have no plans to sell Colombia forward Luis Diaz, despite reported interest from Al-Hilal, and the 29-year-old has told the German champions he wants to stay with them. (Sky Sports Germany)
Everton will demand around £70m for Senegal winger Iliman Ndiaye, 26, amid interest from Manchester United and Al-Hilal. (Mirror)
Manchester United are willing to let Dutch striker Joshua Zirkzee leave and are in talks with Juventus about a deal for the 25-year-old. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)
Nottingham Forest are close to securing a 40m euros (£34m) deal to sign 22-year-old Ivory Coast centre-back Ousmane Diomande from Sporting. (A Bola - in Portuguese)
Coventry City have agreed a club record deal worth an initial £22.5m deal to sign English goalkeeper Carl Rushworth, 25, from Brighton . (Telegraph - subscription required)

Former Arsenal defender Takehiro Tomiyasu, 27, is training with Crystal Palace having left Ajax in the summer, but no talks have taken place about the Japan international joining the Eagles. (Talksport)
Manchester City midfielder Kalvin Phillips is finalising a loan to championship side Sheffield United after being left out of the club's squad list for their pre-season tour. (Mail)
Paris St-Germain have no plans to pursue a move for Manchester City 's World Cup-winning Spain midfielder Rodri. (Sky Sports)
However, City are bracing themselves for a bid from Spanish giants Real Madrid for the 30-year-old but remain hopeful he will sign a new contract. (Guardian)
Leeds United are set to agree a £40m deal to sign 23-year-old England goalkeeper James Trafford from Manchester City . (Athletic - subscription required)
Manchester United have entered advanced talks to send Netherlands forward Joshua Zirkzee, 25, on a season-long loan to Juventus in a deal that includes an option to buy at £30m. (Sun)
Paris St-Germain are interested in Parma's Zion Suzuki, the 23-year-old Japan goalkeeper who has been linked with Aston Villa and Juventus . (Sky Sport - in Italian)
Crystal Palace have reached an agreement on personal terms with Brest's 19-year-old French centre-back Raphael Le Guen. (L'Equipe - in French)

Paris St-Germain 's Ibrahim Mbaye has been offered to both Liverpool and Manchester City after his agents made it clear the Senegal forward, 18, will not be joining Aston Villa this summer. (Teamtalk)
Paris St-Germain want £145m for 23-year-old France forward Bradley Barcola, with Arsenal and Liverpool interested. (Times - subscription)
Arsenal have not opened talks over signing Brazil forward Vinicius Jr, but Real Madrid have set a price of 160m euros (£137m) to sell the 26-year-old this summer. (Sport - in Spanish)
Arsenal would be willing to offer Vinicius the biggest contract in the club's history. (Mirror)
Vinicius' priority is to sign a new deal at Real Madrid . He has a year left on his contract. (AS - in Spanish)
Arsenal are set to accelerate talks over signing Newcastle 's 28-year-old Brazil midfielder Bruno Guimaraes. (TalkSport)
Guimaraes has told his representatives he wants his future resolved in the next week, before he reports back for Newcastle 's pre-season training camp. (TeamTalk)
Tottenham are favourites to sign Brazil winger Savinho, 22, from Manchester City . (Sun)
Real Madrid have agreed personal terms with RB Leipzig's 19-year-old Ivory Coast winger Yan Diomande. (Sky Sports)
Al-Hilal have opened talks over signing Senegal winger Iliman Ndiaye, 26, from Everton . (Fabrizio Romano)
Chelsea will demand a significant fee for Portugal winger Pedro Neto, 26, amid interest from Liverpool , Manchester City and Saudi Arabian teams. (Mail)
Besiktas are waiting for a decision from Egypt forward Mohamed Salah, 34, after submitting their final offer. He is a free agent after leaving Liverpool . (Mail)
Bournemouth are not looking to sell 20-year-old French striker Junior Kroupi, despite interest from Barcelona . (Marca - in Spanish)
Fulham are the leading option for 18-year-old Argentina midfielder Franco Mastantuono if Real Madrid send him on loan next season. (AS - in Spanish)
Juventus are working on a deal to sign Netherlands forward Joshua Zirkzee, 25, from Manchester United . (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)
Portugal midfielder Joao Palhinha, 31, wants to fight for his place at Bayern Munich but they are looking to sell him. (Bild - in German)
Arsenal are exploring a move to sign Brazil winger Vinicius Jr if the 26-year-old does not extend his contract with Real Madrid . (Athletic - subscription required)

New Real Madrid manager Jose Mourinho would oppose any Arsenal approach for Vinicius this summer as the Portuguese boss has told the club he wants all his big names to stay. ( Telegraph - subscription required )
Arsenal are prepared to break the British transfer record to sign Argentina striker Julian Alvarez, 26, from Atletico Madrid . (Teamtalk)
Inter Milan are interested in signing Argentina defender Cristian Romero, 28, from Tottenham . (Sky Sports)
RB Leipzig have rejected an £85.4m bid from Real Madrid for Ivory Coast winger Yan Diomande. The 19-year-old is also a target of Liverpool and Manchester City among others. (Sky Sports)
Manchester United 's lack of urgency to make a concrete offer for 25-year-old France midfielder Manu Kone is frustrating AS Roma . ( Corriere dello Sport - in Italian )
Juventus are exploring a move for Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes, 31, with the Italian club having held talks with the Portugal midfielder's representatives. ( Caught Offside )
Chelsea have rejected a third bid from Como for England defender Trevoh Chalobah, 27. (Talksport)
Napoli are interested in signing Chelsea 's former France centre-back Benoit Badiashile, 25. ( Sun )
Julian Brandt has offers from both Leeds United and Ajax after the 30-year-old Germany midfielder left Borussia Dortmund as a free agent. ( Sky Sports )
Nottingham Forest have submitted an improved £17.5m bid for Feyenoord's 20-year-old Dutch right-back Givairo Read. ( Mail )
West Ham have rejected an offer from Brentford for Senegal left-back El Hadji Malick Diouf and insist the 21-year-old is not for sale. (Talksport)
Middlesbrough are interested in signing Manchester United 's 22-year-old Czech goalkeeper Radek Vitek, who spent last season on loan at Bristol City . ( Sky Sports )

Real Madrid are working on a deal to sign Manchester City midfielder Rodri, with the Spanish club confident an agreement can be reached for the 30-year-old Spain captain. (Athletic - subscription required)

Arsenal are considering a player-plus-cash deal for Atletico Madrid and Argentina striker Julian Alvarez, 26, which would see 28-year-old Sweden forward Viktor Gyokeres move to the La Liga club. (Cadena Ser - in Spanish)
Roma are interested in signing Norway winger Oscar Bobb from Fulham even though the 23-year-old only moved to Craven Cottage from Manchester City six months ago. (Retsport via Football Italia)

Paris St-Germain have yet to make a formal bid of £102m (120m euros) to sign RB Leipzig's Ivory Coast winger Yan Diomande, 19, which has given fresh hope to Liverpool , Arsenal , Real Madrid and Manchester City . (Bild - in German)

Newcastle 's Brazil midfielder Bruno Guimaraes, 28, remains Arsenal 's main target this summer, but Bournemouth 's 22-year-old England international Alex Scott is also a midfield option. (Telegraph - subscription required)
Arsenal 's offer of £70m for Guimaraes will be rejected by Newcastle but the player is keen on a move to the Gunners. (Times - subscription required)
Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta is willing to pay up to £90m to clinch a deal to sign Guimaraes. (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish)
Manchester United are not looking to sell captain Bruno Fernandes, 31, despite speculation linking the Portugal midfielder with a move away from Old Trafford. (Teamtalk)

Como are expected to meet with Chelsea on Saturday as they push for the signing of England defender Trevoh Chalobah, 27, but he will not be allowed to leave for anything less than £30m. (Sky Italia - in Italian)
Chelsea have submitted an initial offer for 18-year-old Bayer Leverkusen and Bosnia-Herzegovina winger Kerim Alajbegovic. (Kicker - in German)
Arsenal and Hamburg are in talks over 26-year-old Portugal midfielder Fabio Vieira who wants to join the Bundesliga club after a loan spell there last season. (Florian Plettenberg)

England striker Marcus Rashford has been invited to be part of a Manchester United fly-on-the-wall documentary by Amazon which suggests senior figures are willing to keep the 28-year-old at the club. (Mirror)
La Liga giants Real Madrid are open to selling 26-year-old France defensive midfielder Aurelien Tchouameni to Manchester United . ( Sun )

AS Roma and France midfielder Manu Kone, 25, and Brighton 's 22-year-old Cameroon international Carlos Baleba are also being considered by Manchester United as they aim to strengthen their midfield. (Sky Sports)
Bournemouth 's 27-year-old United States midfielder Tyler Adams, valued at about £35m, is also an option for Michael Carrick's side. ( Mail )

Former Manchester City defender John Stones, 32, and 28-year-old Ezri Konsa of Aston Villa are among Arsenal targets as the Gunners turn to the England duo after an injury to France defender William Saliba, 25. ( Sky Sports )

Chelsea are favourites to sign Bosnia-Herzegovina attacking midfielder Kerim Alajbegovic, 18, from Bayer Leverkusen, while Xabi Alonso's side are also in talks with Crystal Palace to sell French centre-back Axel Disasi, 28. ( Telegraph - subscription required )
Chelsea have also agreed a deal to sign 15-year-old American winger Benji Flowers from Major League Soccer side FC Dallas when he turns 18. ( Athletic - subscription required )

Arsenal and Manchester City are among the clubs in a race to sign Ivory Coast winger Yan Diomande from RB Leipzig , who previously rejected a £69m bid from Liverpool for the 19-year-old. ( Bild - in German )

Liverpool are confident they can beat Arsenal and Bayern Munich to the signature of Paris St-Germain forward Bradley Barcola, after the 23-year-old impressed with four goal contributions at the World Cup with France this summer. (Sun)

Arsenal are edging the battle with Manchester United for sought-after Bournemouth midfielder Alex Scott, 22 - but the England Under-21 international has concerns around how much game time he would get at the Emirates. (Mirror)
Scott is keen on a move to Chelsea after the Cherries rejected a £64m bid from the Blues. (The Standard)
Portugal midfielder Bruno Fernandes, 31, has decided to commit his future to Manchester United , with talks around a new deal ongoing. (Express)
Besiktas are trying to sign English midfielder Joe Willock, 26, who is in the final year of his contract at Newcastle and will not be offered a new deal. (Telegraph)
Arsenal are not ruling out the sale of their captain Martin Odegaard, and will listen to offers for the 27-year-old Norway midfielder. (Teamtalk)
Manchester United are exploring a move for Real Madrid midfielder Eduardo Camavinga, 23, who missed out on a place in France's World Cup squad this summer. (Nicolo Schira)
Roma have asked about the availability of Chelsea centre-back Axel Disasi, 28 - and the Blues have set an asking price of around £17m for the Frenchman. (Footmercato - in French)
Fulham have opened negotiations with Real Madrid over a potential move for highly-rated striker Gonzalo Garcia, 22. (The Athletic - subscription required)

Tottenham , Chelsea and Arsenal are all plotting a move for Manchester United forward Marcus Rashford, 28, but the Old Trafford hierarchy do not want to sell him to another English club. (The I - subscription required)

Aston Villa 's Argentina goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez, 33, is a target for Juventus while Arsenal are interested in Villa's 28-year-old England defender Ezri Konsa. (Telegraph - subscription required)
Nottingham Forest are in advanced talks to sign Sporting CP and Ivory Coast defender Ousmane Diomande, 22. (Fabrizio Romano)
West Ham's French centre-back Jean-Clair Todibo, 26, is wanted by Juventus . (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)

Manchester United remain keen to sign a central midfielder but have cooled their interest in Brighton 's Cameroon international Carlos Baleba and Bournemouth 's Guernseyman Alex Scott, both 22, because of their high price tags. (Teamtalk)

Bournemouth are determined to keep hold of Scott, who is interesting Arsenal , even though the England Under-21 international has rejected a new contract with the Cherries. (Telegraph - subscription required)
Ipswich have agreed a deal in principle to sign Celtic's Japanese forward Daizen Maeda, 28, for £8m plus £2m in add-ons. (Sky Sports)
Manchester United 's 18-year-old Australian full-back James Overy is being monitored by Rangers and several clubs in Australia. (Mail Plus - subscription required)
Manchester United lead the chase for Roma and France midfielder Manu Kone, 25, but face competition for his signature from Arsenal . (L'Equipe - in French)

The Gunners have also revived their interest in Athletic Club winger Nico Williams, who was part of Spain's World Cup-winning squad, with the 23-year-old believed to have a £77m release clause. (Teamtalk)

West Ham have rejected a second offer from Roma for Dutch forward Crysencio Summerville and the Italian club, whose first bid was 46m euros (£39m), are working on a final proposal for the 24-year-old. (Sky Sports Italia - in Italian)
Aston Villa are weighing up a move for Summerville as they look to replace 23-year-old England attacking midfielder Morgan Rogers, who is set to join Chelsea . (Talksport)

Barcelona have set up a meeting with 26-year-old forward Ferran Torres, who scored Spain's winner in the World Cup final against Argentina, to find out what his plans are with one year left on his contract and interest from Paris St-Germain. (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish)
Ipswich Town have agreed a deal to sign 29-year-old Morocco centre-back Issa Diop from Fulham for about 10m euros (£8.5m). (Foot Mercato - in French)

Newcastle and Leeds are among the Premier League clubs weighing up a move for FC Midtjylland striker Franculino Dju, 22, with the Danish club seeking in excess of £21m for the Guinea-Bissau international. (Teamtalk)

AC Milan have identified young Genk winger Konstantinos Karetsas, 18, as their next summer transfer target but may have to sell Portugal forward Rafael Leao, 27, to fund the move. (Gazzetta - in Italian)
Arsenal are considering signing 32-year-old England defender John Stones on a free transfer if 25-year-old France defender William Saliba's injury turns out to be long term. (Sun)
Chelsea have held formal talks with Crystal Palace over a move for France defender Maxence Lacroix with the Eagles valuing the 26-year-old around £55m. (Talksport)
Hull City are in talks with Aston Villa over a deal for 28-year-old Jamaica winger Leon Bailey. (Athletic - subscription required)

New Fulham manager Alvaro Arbeloa wants to sign two players from former club Real Madrid , including 18-year-old Argentina winger Franco Mastantuono and 22-year-old Spain forward Gonzalo Garcia. (Sun)
Bologna's 23-year-old English winger Jonathan Rowe remains on Aston Villa and Chelsea 's shortlists. (Calciomercato - in Italian)
Hull City are closing in on the signing of 30-year-old former Newcastle left-back Matt Targett, who is a free agent after leaving the club this summer. (Mail)
Liverpool are prepared to join Manchester United in the race for Roma's 25-year-old France midfielder Manu Kone. (Football Insider)
Aston Villa have held talks with Chelsea over the possibility of signing both Nicolas Jackson and Alejandro Garnacho this summer. (Teamtalk)
AC Milan's Portugal forward Rafael Leao would prefer a move to the Premier League rather than Turkey, with Aston Villa a potential destination for the 27-year-old. (Gazzetta - in Italian)
Lazio are targeting West Ham's DR Congo defender Aaron Wan-Bissaka, with the 28-year-old also on Arsenal 's list of potential options. (Mail)

Juventus' number one goalkeeping target is Aston Villa 's 33-year-old Argentina international Emiliano Martinez, while the Serie A club is also keeping an eye on Fiorentina's 35-year-old Spain goalkeeper David de Gea. (Calciomercato - in Italian)
Everton could rival Inter Milan in the race to sign Tottenham 's 25-year-old England defender Djed Spence. (Football Insider)
Liverpool want to sign Sweden left-back Daniel Svensson from Borussia Dortmund, but may face competition from Arsenal for the 24-year-old's signature. (Caught Offside)
Tottenham remain confident of signing Manchester City 's 22-year-old Brazil winger Savinho. (Fabrizio Romano)
Real Madrid have no intention of signing Manchester City 's 30-year-old Spain midfielder Rodri this summer. (Athletic - subscription required)
AC Milan are keeping tabs on 26-year-old Manchester City and England midfielder Phil Foden. ( Tuttosport ).
But any deal for Foden would only be possible if AC Milan are able to sell 27-year-old Portugal forward Rafael Leao. ( Tuttosport )
Leicester City defender Ben Nelson has told the club he wants to leave with Manchester United and West Ham interested in the 22-year-old Englishman. (Mail)
Arsenal are set to sign English defender Elijah Upson after the 18-year-old turned down a new contract with Tottenham . (Fabrizio Romano)
Portugal midfielder Joao Palhinha is expected to return to Bayern Munich for the start of pre-season with reports the 31-year-old is due to sign for Aston Villa wide of the mark. (Sky Germany)
Liverpool are set to sign 17-year-old Colombian midfielder Samuel Martinez from Atletico Nacional for about £750,000. (Athletic - subscription required)
Real Madrid , Barcelona and Atletico Madrid are interested in signing 28-year-old Tottenham and Argentina defender Cristian Romero. (Teamtalk)
Juventus are ahead of Borussia Dortmund and Sunderland in the race to sign USA forward Folarin Balogun, 25, from Monaco. (Mundo Deportivo)
Chelsea are still in talks to sign 26-year-old France defender Maxence Lacroix, but Crystal Palace 's asking price of about £70m is stalling the deal. (Caught Offside)
Juventus remain interested in Tottenham 's 29-year-old Brazil forward Richarlison. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)
Everton are favourites to sign 24-year-old English winger Jaden Philogene from Ipswich. (Football Insider)
Arsenal have made 23-year-old Aston Villa and England midfielder Morgan Rogers their top attacking target and are expected to make an approach, but he could cost more than £100m. (Sky Sports)
Liverpool legend Mohamed Salah will continue his career in Turkey, with the 34-year-old Egypt forward set to sign for Besiktas . (Foot Mercato - in French)
Manchester United are looking at Nottingham Forest wing-back Neco Williams, with the 25-year-old Wales international able to play on either flank. (Football Insider)
Real Madrid are interested in Bayern Munich and France winger Michael Olise, 24, who is tempted by a move to the Bernabeu. (L'Equipe - in French)
Tottenham have rejected a bid worth £46m from Newcastle United for 20-year-old Sweden midfielder Lucas Bergvall. (Athletic - requires subscription)
Chelsea will have to spend £55m if they want Crystal Palace and France defender Maxence Lacroix, 26, this summer. (Times - requires subscription)

Celta Vigo and Guinea midfielder Ilaix Moriba, 23, has been offered to Sunderland , Crystal Palace , Nottingham Forest , Aston Villa and Hull. He could be available for around 20m euros (£17m). (Nos Diario - in Galician)

Bayern Munich have given 31-year-old Portugal midfielder Joao Palhinha, who is no longer part of Vincent Kompany's plans, more time until he has to return to the club. Aston Villa are interested in him. (Record via SportWitness)
Tottenham are interested in signing Netherlands winger Crysencio Summerville from West Ham . The 24-year-old is likely to be available after the Hammers were relegated. (Give Me Sport)
Spurs' summer signing spree means some players will have to leave - with Argentina defender Cristian Romero, 28, likely to go. (Team Talk)
Manchester United and Newcastle United are interested in Eintracht Frankfurt's 22-year-old Sweden midfielder Hugo Larsson, but neither club has made an offer yet. (Bild - in German)
Juventus have offered Aston Villa 6.5m euros (£5.5m) for 33-year-old Argentina goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez, but Villa want 12m euros (£10.2m). (La Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)
Juventus lead the race for Monaco and United States forward Folarin Balogun, 25, with Borussia Dortmund and Sunderland also interested. (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish)
Inter Milan are working on deals for Tottenham 's England defender Djed Spence, 25, and Argentina centre-back Cristian Romero, 28. (Corriere dello Sport - in Italian)

Liverpool are leading the race to sign Japan midfielder Kaishu Sano from Mainz and are prepared to offer up to 60m euros (£50.9m) for the 25-year-old, who has also attracted interest from Arsenal , Tottenham and Borussia Dortmund . (Teamtalk)
Arsenal have expressed an interested in Aston Villa and England defender Ezri Konsa, 28. (Guardian)
Liverpool have asked Bournemouth about 19-year-old winger Rayan as they aim to reunite the Brazilian with former head coach Andoni Iraola. (Teamtalk)
Crystal Palace and Argentina goalkeeper Walter Benitez, 33, could terminate his Palace contract in order to return to Nice . (Nice-Matin - in French)
Newcastle are in talks with Brighton goalkeeper Carl Rushworth, 25, and with fellow Englishman James Trafford, Manchester City 's 23-year-old goalkeeper. (Mail - requires subscription)
Fulham have joined Coventry and Chelsea in looking at Strasbourg and Ivory Coast winger Martial Godo, 23. (Africafoot - in French)
Ipswich have made an approach for 22-year-old Leicester and Ghana winger Abdul Fatawu. (Telegraph)
Crystal Palace are interested in signing Augsburg defender Chrislain Matsima, 24, with the Frenchman one of a number of centre-back options under consideration. (Standard)
Leeds are continuing with their pursuit of Parma and Japan goalkeeper Zion Suzuki, 23, despite the Italian's club's reluctance to let him go. (Tuttomercatoweb - in Italian)
Manchester United will target West Ham winger Crysencio Summerville, 24, if Marcus Rashford leaves this summer, with the Netherlands attacker costing about £30m. (Guardian - subscription required)
Arsenal are preparing an offer of about £34m for RB Leipzig's 21-year-old Norway winger Antonio Nusa. (Caughtoffside)
Manchester City have informed Lille's Ayyoub Bouaddi they want to bring the 18-year-old Morocco midfielder straight into the first team rather than loan him back to the French club. (Teamtalk)
Manchester City are looking at Paris St-Germain's Senegal forward Ibrahim Mbaye, 18, after interest from Aston Villa and Tottenham . (FootMercato)
Sunderland are lining up a move to sign 19-year-old French defender Dayann Methalie from Toulouse. (Football Insider)
Everton are considering a move for Manchester City right-back Rico Lewis, with Nottingham Forest , Bournemouth and Fulham also interested in the 21-year-old Englishman. (Teamtalk)

Hull City are expected to finalise a move this week for Swedish winger Elliot Stroud, 24, from Mjallby in a deal worth £3m - and also hopeful of completing the signing of Olympiacos and Greece goalkeeper Konstantinos Tzolakis, 23. (Sky Sports)
Arsenal have explored the possibility of offering Sweden striker Viktor Gyokeres, 28, as part of a deal for Atletico Madrid's Argentina forward Julian Alvarez, 26. (Talksport)
Barcelona will resume their pursuit of Alvarez after the World Cup and could also include one of their players as part of the deal. (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish)

Barcelona want to offer Spain forward Ferran Torres, 26, a new contract amid interest from Paris St-Germain , but plan to wait until September because of financial regulations. (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish)
Liverpool have made fresh contact with Paris St-Germain over a potential summer move for France forward Bradley Barcola, 23. (TeamTalk)
Arsenal are trying to sell Brazil forward Gabriel Jesus, with AC Milan among the leading contenders to sign the 29-year-old. (TeamTalk)
Sunderland are set to complete the signing of Belgium right-back Thomas Meunier following the 34-year-old's departure from Lille . (Athletic - subscription required)
Liverpool have dismissed a new approach for Curtis Jones, with Inter Milan's improved bid of about £27m falling short of their £30m asking price for the 25-year-old England midfielder. (Talksport)
Everton have stepped up their long-standing interest in Genoa's Brooke Norton-Cuffy, 22, with fresh talks having taken place over a potential move for the England Under-21 defender. (TeamTalk)
Tottenham captain Cristian Romero, 28, is set to leave the club this summer, with Barcelona interested in the Argentina defender. (Talksport)
Crysencio Summerville's agents have met with Roma over the Netherlands forward, 24, joining them from West Ham . (Corriere dello Sport - in Italian)
